text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- German foreign minister's aide Werner Hoyer visits Algeria. Since Algerian presidential elections last year, German officials have begun looking at the Algerian market.
- Homeless man shot dead in Algiers by two gunmen.

- The government holds a two-day conference on privatisation. The World Bank initiated the meeting in which several experts from the bank will talk about similar privatisation processes abroad and compare them with the Algerian experience.
- Arab police convene on Monday a three-day meeting to discuss crime and security cooperation between Arab states.
- President Liamine Zeroual will announce on Sunday a date for the referendum to amend the constitution.
- Armed group strikes again in Laghouat: two people killed and third tortured.
